profile.title_role: Ph.D. Researcher in Materials Science & Engineering
profile.bio: As a Doctoral Researcher at Sungkyunkwan University pursuing a Doctor of Science degree, I focus on advancing the field through innovative simulations and leveraging strong analytical skills. My academic foundation includes a Master’s Degree in Physics from Hanoi University of Science and Technology (2024). I collaborate on research initiatives aimed at addressing critical energy challenges, utilizing simulation tools to analyze complex systems. My work reflects a commitment to driving impactful solutions in semiconductor technologies while contributing to academic and scientific advancements.
